title: ci: deploy legacy caches from master
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a manual GitHub Actions deploy for the legacy image and text cache Workers.
- Runs on the default branch but checks out legacy master; no modern production branch involved.
- Tests both caches before deploying with the existing Cloudflare account credentials.

gist.headline: Old caches, fresh button
gist.blurb: The legacy image and text caches have a manual deploy button. It tests them first, then fetches their code from master—no detour through the modern production branch.
gist.summary: Added a manual GitHub Actions workflow on the default branch that checks out legacy master, tests both image and text cache Workers, then deploys them with the existing Cloudflare credentials.
gist.impact: Maintainers can deploy the tested legacy cache Workers without involving the modern production branch.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed deploy station with two labeled cache boxes for images and text, a test checklist, and a path from an old 'master' code shelf to a Cloudflare Worker terminal. Polli, wearing a tiny tool belt, presses a manual deploy button; the imagery should make clear this is a maintainer workflow, not a new user feature.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli presses a lime green (#ecf874) manual deploy button beside two little cache boxes marked 'IMAGE' and 'TEXT,' with checked test cards and a vine-lined path from an old 'master' code shelf to a glowing terminal. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny tool belt, is small-to-medium sized within the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients over a warm cream background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
